title: Paired decomposition of the quadratic bit
statement: Let $r$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers with $r\le 1$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^{r+2k}$. Define linear coordinate changes $T_{r,k}$ recursively: $T_{r,0}$ is the identity; to form $T_{r,k+1}$, split off the last two coordinates, add the sum of the preceding coordinates to each of those two, apply $T_{r,k}$ to the preceding coordinates, and reassemble. Define linear forms $L_{r,0}=0$ and $L_{r,k+1}(x)=L_{r,k}(x_{<r+2k})+\sum_{i<r+2k}x_i$, where $x_{<r+2k}$ is the prefix of length $r+2k$. Then, in $\mathbb{F}_2$, $\sum_{i<j}x_i x_j=L_{r,k}(x)+\sum_{j=0}^{k-1}(T_{r,k}x)_{r+2j}(T_{r,k}x)_{r+2j+1}$.
